description.value:
Night Citizens disagree on a lot, but there's one common platform they share: a gun should be available for everyone, no matter the thickness of their wallet, their age, their criminal history, the time of day and, most importantly, no questions asked. The Slaught-O-Matic is a real-life manifestation of that philosophy (if you can call it that). But when you've fired the last round, don't bother reloading. Just toss it and buy a new one.

Cost: 10eb (Cheap)

Class: Poor Quality SMG • Skill: Handgun • Range: Subcompact SMG

Damage: 2d6 • Capacity: 36 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Pistol 3), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 0 • Attachments: None • Mods: None

Special Features: This weapon’s magazine comes pre-loaded with 36 rounds of Basic Ammunition, which cannot be removed or replaced without making this weapon Destroyed Beyond Repair.

Range: Subcompact SMG
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Pistol 3), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
